target_customer: Physical therapy clinics billing Medicare and insurers for remote therapeutic monitoring
problem: Clinics miss RTM reimbursements because collecting them is manual. Kips Health said its software collected RTM payments with about five minutes of work.
business_model: B2B SaaS tied to RTM reimbursement revenue
product_category: Patient engagement and RTM billing software

founders.name: Jarrett Perkins
founders.background_notes: YC page: software engineer at Asana. Education not listed.

founders.name: Eric Wang
founders.background_notes: YC page lists his current role as product at Wander. Education not listed.

technical_complexity.rationale: Patient engagement and billing workflow software for RTM codes was standard integration work; the difficulty was clinic adoption and reimbursement rules.

defensibility.rationale: RTM billing tools were easy to replicate, with established PT software vendors able to add the same feature.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: These vendors advertise RTM features per search results, but the dates of those launches were not found, so their timing relative to Kips Health is unknown.

market_need_then: Medicare RTM billing codes existed from 2022, creating a reimbursement stream clinics wanted to capture, per the company's pitch that its software pays the clinic; no independent demand data was verified.

identity.voice_and_tone: Tagline: the only patient engagement software that pays you

branding.brand_signature: Tagline about software that pays you

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community coverage; search results confuse it with the acquired Kip Health, a different company.

pivots.from: RTM reimbursement software for physical therapists
pivots.to: Advent, UGC first video games with generative AI
pivots.why: not stated by the founders; the YC page carries an Advent launch post listing Eric and Jarrett, and an aggregator dated 2023-08-28 describes it, but it is unclear whether it replaced or ran alongside the RTM product

outcome_analysis: The cause of Kips Health's inactive status is not public. The founders launched an Advent video game project in August 2023 while still in the batch, which suggests a possible shift in focus, but no source states why the RTM business stopped. An aggregator citing PitchBook reports an out of business entry in October 2024, which is unverified. No failure factors are assigned.
notes: The $500K pre-seed rests on one aggregator (VCBacked); another source mentions $1M, unverified, and no SEC Form D was found per a search summary. The PitchBook out of business date of October 2024 comes only from a search summary of an aggregator and is not recorded as the exit date. No company website exists in the dataset. Competitor search found RTM vendors but no sources dated near mid 2023, so the list is empty.
